page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at left; heading in two lines centred; an engraving (emblem picture) in a framed box; below it a four-line verse in italic centred; a catchword-like word "Mira" at the lower right.

main_text.head: DEVORANT PAUPEREM, ET devorantur à Satana.

p.i: Dives, & à stygio carpitur ipse Lare:
Væ qui prædaris, nam tu quoq; præda futurus,

page.notes: The engraving shows a horned, winged demon with a long tail, holding and devouring a small naked figure, while a kneeling man in a long robe kneels at right; a city with domes lies in the background. The word "Mira" at lower right is printed in the margin as a catchword-style mark; it is placed as a side note. The verse line 1 ends with a printed flourish after "ritu"; the word "Ingrati" line is as printed.
